implementation.targetScope: Capacitor/Ionic asset copying, native-project moves, JSON config, output/ensure/remove helpers and callback/Promise native filesystem operations. Shared independently written sync/async traversal; only VPM jsonfile is a package dependency.

differences: Overlapping directory trees and convenience removal of filesystem roots reject explicitly.
Destination directory symlinks are not merged; file copies do not write through destination symlinks. Symlink no-clobber is honored.
Special device, socket and FIFO copying is outside scope; no graceful-fs global patches or descriptor retry queue.
Synchronous async filters reject; filters cannot bypass the post-filter source check; options remain unmodified.
emptyDir resolves undefined rather than incidental arrays or created-path values. Custom validation messages can differ.
Cross-device fallback uses injected tests; real cross-device mounts and Windows acceptance remain unverified.
No public release or application adoption claimed.
